//: Copy to devcdp.config.json and edit. Every field is optional; DevCDP works with none of them set. Environment variables (DEVCDP_*) override this file, and tool arguments override both.
//docsRoot: Where to read the app's own README and docs, so the assistant can learn your domain vocabulary instead of guessing. Defaults to the working directory when that looks like a repository.
//sharedMemoryDir: A path several people can reach — a network share, or a folder in your repo. Learned fixes written here are read by every teammate's DevCDP, which is what makes recovery knowledge accumulate instead of staying on one laptop.
//dialogSelectors: Extra CSS selectors for modals that structural detection misses. Dialog detection is standards-based first (role=dialog, aria-modal, the dialog element) then geometric, so most apps need nothing here.
//testAttributes: Attributes preferred when building selectors, most trustworthy first.
//apiProbePaths: Where to look for an OpenAPI/Swagger document when mapping the backend. Add yours if it lives somewhere non-standard.
//port: Chrome remote-debugging port to attach to by default.
//portRange: Range used when a session asks for its own separate browser.
//badge: Show the on-page badge that tells the user which session is driving the tab, and carries the confirmation button for manual handovers. Turn it off only if it interferes with visual testing.
//badgeCorner: Where the overlay parks before you move it: tc | bc (top/bottom centre) or tl | tr | bl | br. Top centre by default, because every corner is somewhere an app already puts a control. Drag the chip to move it; the drop position is remembered per origin, and the status messages travel with it.
//disableWebSecurity: Leave false. Disabling web security makes CORS and cross-origin bugs unreproducible in the very browser you debug in — the previous launcher always set it, which hid exactly the class of bug people were asking about.
//captureInputValues: Record the values typed into fields. Off by default: field contents are frequently personal or confidential. Password-type and sensitive-looking fields stay redacted even when this is on.
//buffers: How much observation history to hold in memory. Anything evicted is reported rather than silently dropped.
